material_claim_inventory.title: Frozen capture authority, scope and pins

atomic_decisions.decision: The admitted capture is the 0.5 specification, 896 lines; both brief groups share one S003-only bounded assignment.
No-live-fetch/no-execution self-descriptions are retained; supplied artifact/read metadata does not establish every native action. Validation remains designated UNEXECUTED.
Plan and brief are product authority; the Tools pointer supplies no actual reader code, behavior, benchmarks or real-fileset results.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Release, draft compatibility and future migration

atomic_decisions.decision: Current released edition is 0.5; migrations are promised, not supplied in this capture; 0.5.0/0.5.1/0.5.2 history entries are correctly quoted.

Draft-written data will not necessarily be supported, a weaker condition than categorically unsupported. Only-0.5 admission is a product boundary; the source does not say 0.5 is the only version ever released.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Normative, example and RFC boundaries

atomic_decisions.decision: RFC vocabulary and lowercase readability are established; all text is normative except explicit non-normative sections, examples and notes.
JSON comments shown for clarity MUST NOT enter real JSON.

A diagram/comment/example can illustrate a supported rule, but examples cannot independently impose universal reader UI or rendering obligations. Descriptive normative text also binds; uppercase keywords are not the sole source of requirements.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Transitional metadata context

atomic_decisions.decision: bioformats2raw.layout and omero are transitional; future removal and usually optional writing are captured.
The general statement that implementations may be expected MUST or encouraged SHOULD is contextual; it does not impose unconditional reading of every transitional field.
Read-only and session-local behavior comes from the brief/plan, not a source requirement to write data.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Zarr v3 substrate and allowed features

atomic_decisions.decision: Zarr v3 is required; codecs, grids, key encodings, data types and transformers may be used unless explicitly disallowed; array decoding depends on Zarr array metadata.
The admitted capture does not provide the external Zarr specification or codec implementation coverage. Backend limits need truthful product handling.
Label arrays are an explicit integer-dtype restriction, so whole-capture claims that no disallowance exists are false; general intensity-image encodings remain broadly admitted.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Local versus remote format and product boundary

atomic_decisions.decision: Hierarchy can be local, HTTP or object storage; local-only reading is an explicit product scope choice. Editing/export/clinical interpretation remain outside the brief.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Metadata namespace and version consistency

atomic_decisions.decision: Metadata resides in attributes.ome in zarr.json, version is a string, and versions MUST agree within a hierarchy.
Missing namespace/version and inconsistent hierarchy require admission validation or an explicit unsupported outcome within the product promise.
Hard failure versus subtree rejection or caveated best effort and message wording are product decisions; version!=0.5 is outside the brief, not proof of intrinsic malformedness for all OME versions.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Image group and per-level array identity

atomic_decisions.decision: Images are groups and levels separate arrays; multiscales metadata belongs to groups, decoding metadata to each array.
Single image, HCS and transitional collections are materially distinct entry shapes. Label container itself is not an image; contained label images are images.
A required sniffing order beyond plate-over-collection and a particular image-list UI are derived product designs, not additional source algorithms.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: HCS hierarchy and empty groups

atomic_decisions.decision: HCS requires plate, row and well groups above field images; well and plate implement their specifications.
Empty rows/wells SHOULD NOT be present; recommendation does not prove none can occur. Sparse metadata lists differ from dense grid inference.
No-crash handling and empty-item listing are product policies retained as such, not specified native reader behavior.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Plate rows and columns

atomic_decisions.decision: Every physical row/column is listed, including empty ones. Names are alphanumeric, case-sensitive and unique within the list; collision avoidance is SHOULD.
Case-folding or guessed dense well expansion loses declared identity. Retain exact spelling on a local filesystem.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Plate well paths and indices

atomic_decisions.decision: Well paths are exactly row/column without extra leading/trailing directories; rowIndex and columnIndex are 0-based and must agree with the path.
Sparse example C/5 and D/7 illustrates that wells are not row×column expansion; no fabricated empty-well images.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Plate acquisition metadata

atomic_decisions.decision: acquisitions MAY be present; ids MUST be unique nonnegative integers; names and positive maximumfieldcount SHOULD be present; description and integer epoch start/end MAY be present.
Displaying names/counts/times and acquisition-aware UI grouping are justified choices, not source-mandated presentation. No timestamp unit beyond epoch integer is asserted.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Plate and well version/count hints

atomic_decisions.decision: plate.version MUST be a string; well.version SHOULD be present with string value; field_count/name are SHOULD fields with conditional type restrictions.
Accept-and-display when version vocabularies are not specified is a product proposal; treating well.version presence as universally required exceeds its SHOULD.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Well image identity and acquisition linkage

atomic_decisions.decision: well.images MUST enumerate all fields; paths must be alphanumeric, case-sensitive and unique. If multiple acquisitions were performed, an integer acquisition must match a plate id.
The exact trigger is performed acquisitions, not necessarily only metadata-list length. A >1-entry heuristic is a retained, explicitly proposed interpretation, not source proof.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Collection layout and plate precedence

atomic_decisions.decision: bioformats2raw.layout identifies multi-image collections; required layout value is 3. If plate metadata is present it takes precedence; mixed plate/image collections are unavailable at present.

Quoted prose value 3 does not establish JSON string type. Numeric JSON examples show 3; accepting numeric/string alternatives is a product compatibility proposal, not an established source inconsistency.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Series list, fallback and OME-XML correspondence

atomic_decisions.decision: OME group MAY contain series; entries are string image paths, ordered like OME-XML Images if provided. With no series and no plate, images use consecutive groups starting 0, one image per series/index.
OME/METADATA.ome.xml SHOULD be present; when supplied it must use OME-XML MetadataOnly rather than BinData, BinaryOnly or TiffData; minimum specification MAY be used.
Missing optional XML is not by itself universal inability to display. Full XML semantics or fixture interoperability cannot be established from this capture.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Multi-image reader choices

atomic_decisions.decision: Readers SHOULD expose multiplicity and SHOULD NOT silently open only the first image; MAY use series, show all or choose, and ignore other root groups.
SHOULD is not a universal MUST. Required multiplicity awareness can follow the product discovery promise, but a flat qualified list is not inherently incapable of HCS identity.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Multiscales entries, datasets and paths

atomic_decisions.decision: multiscales is a list of dictionaries, each with axes and datasets. Each level path is group-relative and ordering largest/highest resolution to smallest, not numeric/lexicographic names.
Levels share dimensionality <=5 matching axes count and order; each carries its own coordinateTransformations.
name/type/downscaling metadata SHOULD be provided; displaying them is product UI. Selection among entries by name/first fallback has illustrative guidance, not a fixed universal viewport algorithm.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Pyramid reduction and available-level handling

atomic_decisions.decision: Metadata order and each level geometry defeat numeric-folder assumptions, fixed factor-two or isotropic reduction assumptions. Missing declared levels cannot be silently invented.
Ordering sanity metric based on total voxel count is a product heuristic, not normative resolution definition. Responsiveness, fallback and unsupported level policy derive from the plan.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Axis names, rank and dimension_names

atomic_decisions.decision: Axis names are arbitrary but MUST be unique; axes length equals array rank, 2..5; dimension_names MUST be in each level array zarr.json and match axes names.
The history one-liner saying dimension_names in axes is less precise than the explicit array-zarr.json requirement; preserve the actual field placement.
Generic best-effort positional inference for missing/custom types is a product policy and cannot manufacture validated semantic axes.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Axis composition and order

atomic_decisions.decision: 2 or 3 space axes, at most one time and one channel/null/custom axis; order parallels array dimensions and time then channel/custom then space.
Stacking spatial zyx order is SHOULD in the stated anisotropic case; arbitrary names cannot alone determine semantic t/c/z.

Two innermost spatial axes as an invariant plane rule is not universally established. Missing dimension and length-one present dimension are different; custom/null types need a truthful explicit policy.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Optional type, units and controls

atomic_decisions.decision: Axis type and physical unit are SHOULD metadata; custom type strings are allowed and multiscales also mentions null/custom. Missing/unknown units must not become invented physical calibration.
No time/channel axis warrants no such dimension slider; a present length-one axis is still present, not proof of absence.
Refusal, generic slider, raw-unit display, conversion/rounding and fallback behavior are product decisions. Intensity/channel compositing semantics for custom axes are not given.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: OMERO presence and required fields

atomic_decisions.decision: omero is optional; if present channels is required, each entry color is six hex RGB digits and window requires min/max/start/end.
Example-only active/coefficient/family/inverted/label/rdefs/id/name are not independently mandatory; WebGateway semantics are outside the capture.

Mandatory metadata fields do not imply MUST apply initial color/window or require all example hints. Honoring them is a reasonable product proposal; malformed color is not unspecified because a six-hex-digit requirement exists.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: OMERO length, defaults and error qualifications

atomic_decisions.decision: channels matching c extent appears in an example comment; absence of a normative match rule is correctly qualified. Absent omero leaves initial contrast/color/T/Z to product choice.
No captured gamma/family registry, crash policy or fully defined window-out-of-range behavior; proposals stay unexecuted.
Claiming every out-of-range window or start>end is a source-proven malformed case goes beyond captured type/presence rules.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: General transformations

atomic_decisions.decision: Transforms are an ordered list with required type; general types identity, translation and scale. Translation/scale may use float lists or a container binary path. Apply sequentially.
The capture does not define full binary-vector dtype/shape/endianness/resolution behavior; support-or-truthful-decline is a product boundary.
Table header appearing after rows is capture formatting, not evidence of semantic loss or contradiction.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Per-level calibrated mapping

atomic_decisions.decision: Image transforms only scale/translation; exactly one scale; at most one translation after scale. Vectors match axes length.
Scale is physical size/duration when known; otherwise current-to-first resolution factor, default 1 without downsampling. Translation is physical offset.
No uniform factor, zero-origin or identical-level mapping may be invented; missing/invalid transforms require truthful handling.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Global composition and coordinate examples

atomic_decisions.decision: Optional image-level transforms obey dataset rules and apply after the dataset list. Reported example vectors and 0.1 time multiplication are present.
Composition needs listed scale-then-translation, followed by global transforms. Conventional function notation scale∘translate reverses the inner order; prose and executable arithmetic must agree.
The supplied reports have no worked nonzero-offset dataset-plus-global arithmetic oracle; validation proposals are retained but not evidence of execution or verified preservation.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Details panel and calibration uncertainty

atomic_decisions.decision: Axis names, dimensions, units and composed coordinates are evidence-grounded topics required by the product promise; missing units/relative factors remain explicit.

Exact panel layout, cursor/view-center display, transform vectors, voxel sizes, pyramid method display and image-group-origin wording are proposed UI policy. Unit presence alone does not prove a scale value is physically calibrated.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Label container, paths and intermediate groups

atomic_decisions.decision: labels container is nested beside original levels; is not itself an image; contains label images with arbitrary names.
ome.labels path array MUST exist; exhaustive listing is SHOULD. Intermediate groups are allowed and MUST NOT contain metadata.
Directory guessing alone is insufficient for declared association, but exclusively forbidding unlisted discovery exceeds SHOULD exhaustiveness.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Integer label data and categorical keys

atomic_decisions.decision: Label dtype list is uint8/int8/uint16/int16/uint32/int32/uint64/int64. Values denote categorical labels. Color/property objects key by integer label-value; order is not category identity.
Label image must implement multiscales and have same number of dataset levels as the original.

Exact integer preservation requires range-safe decoding/lookup; uint64/int64 listings alone are not an exact binary64 range contract. Resampling that creates IDs violates categorical identity even when interpolation policy is product-chosen.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Label registration and size-one dimensions

atomic_decisions.decision: Labels share coordinate system, usually dimensions/transforms; same-or-one overview supports irrelevant dimensions. Each label has its own multiscales geometry and equal level count.
Equal counts or shapes alone do not establish registration or source identity; broadcast/mismatch rejection and resampling choices need coherent validated geometry.
Nearest neighbor/category-preserving display is a defensible derived policy; S003 does not prescribe a named universal interpolation algorithm.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: image-label optionality and palette recommendation

atomic_decisions.decision: image-label SHOULD be present; colors and version SHOULD be present, with conditional array/string constraints. Readers SHOULD use declared colors.
Color entries MUST have integer label-value; optional rgba is four integers 0..255, fourth alpha/opacity; extra keys allowed. Worked 0/1 colors are informative examples.
Treating colors/version presence or honoring palette as unconditional MUST overstates SHOULD. Fallback palette, toggle/opacity UI, blending and property visibility are product choices.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Label properties and source association

atomic_decisions.decision: properties and source MAY exist; properties entries each require integer label-value and may differ in keys. source must be an object, image if present a relative string path to a Zarr image group; default is ../../.

The relative source reference cannot be reduced to annotation only or assumed always the containment parent. Resolve actual source identity before overlaying when provided; deeper intermediate nesting matters.

The ../../ default is an explicit normative sentence at S003 L474, not merely an example. A source-proven default should not be dismissed as nonbinding only because the same token occurs in JSON samples.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Exact key spellings and naming convention

atomic_decisions.decision: CamelCase is a source naming recommendation with historical exceptions. Literal field_count, maximumfieldcount, rowIndex, columnIndex, label-value, starttime/endtime, bioformats2raw.layout must survive.
Source naming conventions do not impose a naming standard on the unrelated session store; session-storage design is product policy.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Performance, cancellation and item-scoped messages

atomic_decisions.decision: Background reads, cancellation, no-freeze acceptance and understandable per-item feedback are product requirements in the brief/plan. S003 gives no threading/cache/prefetch algorithm, performance budget or error strings.
Format violations, optional absence, product capability limits and extra groups need distinct treatment; a list headed cannot display must not imply optional omissions necessarily prevent display.
No synthetic fixture, profiling result or crash-freedom execution is demonstrated by these reports.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Implementation evidence and external dependencies

atomic_decisions.decision: External standards/tools pointers do not supply actual reader implementations. Native interoperability, converter quirks, codec distributions and tolerance/performance behavior remain unresolved in the one-source scope.
Untested interoperability is not a finding of incompatibility. MetadataOnly, WebGateway, UDUNITS and Zarr details beyond capture remain unresolved, not invented mandates.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Explicit uncertainty and counterevidence inventory

atomic_decisions.decision: Arbitrary names, variable axes, optional OMERO, sparse plates, per-level geometry, optional/global translations, units SHOULD, unlisted labels and acquisitions counter fixed-position/dense/numeric-folder assumptions.
Claims to refute thin-plan assumptions must be read as risks: the thin fixture does not itself assert one-image, tczyx, factor-two, dense plates or zero-origin assumptions.
No listed uncertainty or relevant counterevidence is deleted from saved history to final. Capture gaps remain visibly unresolved.

material_claim_inventory.temporal_outcome: retained in final; qualifications/errors separately identified

material_claim_inventory.title: Plan disposition, optional capability and product review

atomic_decisions.decision: Each thin-plan sentence has a retained mapping: opening/listing, canvas, controls, overlays, calibrated details, pyramid choice, responsiveness, failures, interoperability, read-only boundary and acceptance.
